weight_basis: eligible market 24h BTC volume / eligible global 24h BTC volume

weight_fields.weight_ratio: decimal numeric ratio of eligible global 24h BTC volume; 0..1
weight_fields.weight_percent_decimal: percentage expressed as decimal; alias of weight_ratio

global_bpi.weighted: sum(price_usd * weight_ratio) across all eligible global BTC/fiat markets
global_bpi.unweighted: arithmetic mean price_usd across all eligible global BTC/fiat markets

national_bpi.membership: market quote currency matches selected country's national currency
national_bpi.weighted: sum(price_usd * global_weight_ratio) / sum(global_weight_ratio) within selected national subset
national_bpi.unweighted: arithmetic mean price_usd within selected national subset
national_bpi.reason: preserves each market's share of world BTC volume while renormalizing the national subset to a valid price

sanity_gate.price_consensus: median USD-normalized eligible BTC/fiat market price
sanity_gate.note: No market receives any Global BPI or BitAvg weight until every sanity gate passes.
